sources.title: GPT-2 Models for Text Classification - FusionBench
sources.snippet: GPT-2 Models for Text Classification Here we provide a series of GPT-2 models fine-tuned for text classification tasks. The Seven Tasks from GLUE Benchmark We provide seven GPT-2 models fine-tuned on the following tasks from GLUE Benchmark: CoLA, SST-2, MRPC, QQP, MNLI, RTE, and QNLI.
